title: Structure engineering intro
description: A large neo-grotesk statement pinned in the middle of the window for about a screen of scrolling while its words light from pale grey to full ink in reading order, followed by a row of bold uppercase tabs (the chosen one ruled across its top), the chosen tab's mono paragraphs with an outline arrow button at the left, and an image at the lower right. The copy and image rise 48px as they come into view.
notes: the statement wrapper is 235svh on phones and 245svh at desktop: the pinned stretch is that minus one window
word lighting is CSS scroll-driven (a named view timeline); without support the statement is simply full ink
name: structureengineering-intro
